Messages.Author: Miguel
Messages.Body:
Hi Ppl!

Can anybody tell me if this is correct?

If i play a "WAKE WITH EVENING FRESHNESS" or "FORCED AWAKENING" i cannot
play a "DEFLECTION" for example, because the card text, specifically says
"Tap this reacting vampire..." and what the the WAKE or FORCED does is only
remove the tapped vampire restrictions alowing my minion to react by for
example playing intercept and not untaping him/her. Am i right?

You may only play a "DEFLECTION" for example after a "RATS WARNING" but
never after the 2 examples i gave earlier on this post, right?

Thank you from Portugal!

Bruno Robalo

Messages.Author: Fredrik Appelberg
Messages.Body:
Miguel wrote:
> Hi Ppl!
>
> Can anybody tell me if this is correct?
>
> If i play a "WAKE WITH EVENING FRESHNESS" or "FORCED AWAKENING" i cannot
> play a "DEFLECTION" for example, because the card text, specifically says
> "Tap this reacting vampire..." and what the the WAKE or FORCED does is only
> remove the tapped vampire restrictions alowing my minion to react by for
> example playing intercept and not untaping him/her. Am i right?

No.
You may play Deflection after a Wake, as "Tap this reacting vampire" is
an effect of the card being played, and not a requisite for it to be played.

On the other hand, you may not play a card like Babble on superior after
a Wake, as the wording is "Tap this vampire *to* untap another ready
minion" (emphasis added). In this case, tapping the reacting vampire is
a requirement.

Cheers,
-- Fredrik
